detail.longDescription: I am using Milvus 3.0.2 with PyMilvus 3.0.2 . My collection stores camera metadata, including an INT64 field named iso . Creating the collection and inserting data both succeed. I can also retrieve the iso value by querying the primary key. However, filtering directly on iso produces a parsing error. Here is a minimal example: from pymilvus import DataType, MilvusClient client = MilvusClient(uri="http://localhost:19530") name = "iso_repro" schema = client.create_schema(enable_dynamic_field=True) schema.add_field("pk", DataType.INT64, is_primary=True) schema.add_field("vec", DataType.FLOAT_VECTOR, dim=2) schema.add_field("iso", DataType.INT64) schema.add_field("interval", DataType.INT64) schema.add_field("frames", DataType.INT64) client.create_collection(name, schema=schema) indexes = client.prepare_index_params() indexes.add_index( "vec", index_type="FLAT", metric_type="L2", ) client.create_index(name, indexes) client.load_collection(name) client.insert( name, [{ "pk": 1, "vec": [0.1, 0.2], "iso": 400, "interval": 5, "frames": 1200, }], ) print(client.query( name, filter="pk == 1", output_fields=["iso", "interval"], )) print(client.query(name, filter="frames > 1000")) These queries return the stored metadata and the matching record: [{'iso': 400, 'interval': 5, 'pk': 1}] [{'pk': 1}] But this query fails: client.query(name, filter="iso == 400") The error is: failed to create query plan: cannot parse expression: iso == 400: line 1:7 mismatched input '400' expecting Identifier: query plan failed: invalid parameter Changing the expression to ISO == 400 gives the same parsing error. Changing it to Iso == 400 returns an empty result instead. I expected iso == 400 to return the same record as frames > 1000 , since both fields are INT64 and their values were inserted successfully. How can I filter on the existing iso field without changing its name?
